consumer.description: Custom type for representing a foreign key with a null value allowed.

consumer_group.description: Custom type for representing a foreign key with a null value allowed.

protocols.description: A set of strings representing HTTP protocols.

log_statistics.description: If enabled, adds A2A metrics to Kong log plugin(s) output.

log_payloads.description: If enabled, logs request/response bodies to Kong log plugin(s) output. Requires log_statistics to be enabled.

max_payload_size.description: Maximum size in bytes for logged request/response payloads. Payloads exceeding this size will be truncated.

max_request_body_size.description: Maximum size of request body to parse for A2A metadata. Set to 0 for unlimited.
